title: Ptolemy on the soul's ascension through Orion's Belt
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Ptolemy on the soul's ascension through Orion's Belt, about c. 100 AD at Roman world, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: he's saying that the, you know, soul's ascension path is through Orion's Belt.

plain: Ptolemy was an ancient astronomer of the Roman world, writing around 100 AD. A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says Ptolemy wrote that the soul's path upward after death runs through Orion's Belt, the three stars in a row in the Orion constellation. He raises it as ancient support for the idea that some old monuments were linked to those stars.
